_hinweis: Figuren- und Objektblatt für den Aquarellstil (docs/BILDSTIL.md, Abschnitt 4), abgeleitet aus den Pflichtmerkmalen des Bildlexikons; Farben gedeckt nach der Palette. Altersangaben sind Bildgestaltung (R), keine Textfakten.
stil_en: Minimalist watercolour comic illustration for adults: warm white paper with lots of empty white space; very few thin, slightly irregular, deliberately broken ink lines, contours only where they clarify the form; diffuse, transparent watercolour washes with soft edges and visible paper; small warm muted palette of sand, ochre, terracotta, blue-grey, olive and soft ink grey; natural adult proportions and faces with restrained expressions, emotion shown through gaze, posture and gesture; backgrounds only hinted. No stone textures, no detailed folds, no decorative hatching, no glossy or cinematic light, no photorealism, no anime eyes. Historically plausible first-century Galilee and Judea: simple woven garments, sandals, earthenware, stone. Light only from daylight or small clay oil lamps. Clothing of the first century: plain mantles and head coverings, no modern striped prayer shawls.
bild_en: Landscape picture, a single scene (not a comic page, no panel borders, no frame). There is no lettering of any kind and no speech bubbles in the picture. Keep the upper part of the picture above the heads as calm, nearly empty pale wash, because speech bubbles are added there later.

figuren.FIG-JESUS: Jesus: a Galilean man in his early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, short full dark beard, warm brown eyes, olive skin, a kind and open face that is always fully visible like everyone else's; cream linen tunic and a muted terracotta-red mantle over one shoulder. No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.
figuren.FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU: Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-JUENGER: The disciples: a few young and middle-aged men with beards in plain ochre and brown belted robes, bare-headed, staying close to Jesus.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER: The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-coloured belted tunics with pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER: The master of the feast: a portly older man, grey beard, receding grey hair, bare-headed, in an olive-green robe with a wide ochre-gold belt.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM: The bridegroom: a young beardless or lightly bearded man in a muted violet festive robe with a wreath of small fresh flowers on his head.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-HAENDLER: Money changers and dove sellers: ordinary bearded men of different ages with simple striped headcloths, dignified, never caricatured.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE: Jewish people of Jerusalem: men, women and children of different ages in everyday robes in sand, grey, blue-grey and white, some with simple plain head coverings; dignified and varied, never caricatured or stereotyped.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WASSER: Six large stone water jars: waist-high, heavy, plain, pale grey, clearly distinct from small clay pitchers.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KRUG-WEIN-LEER: A small empty clay wine jug.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BECHER-VOLL: A simple earthenware cup with red wine.
figuren.FIG-ORT-TEMPEL: The temple in Jerusalem: tall pale limestone building and colonnades, drawn lightly.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-PEITSCHE: A short whip made of a few knotted cords.

figurenblatt_en: A character reference sheet on warm white paper: the following people standing side by side in a row, full figure, front view, evenly spaced with white space between them, same scale, neutral standing pose, each face clearly visible. From left to right: Mary, Jesus, the master of the feast, the bridegroom, one male and one female servant, two disciples. No names, no lettering.
